import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x, y, n;
        x = sc.nextLong();
        y = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        long bestNum = 1L << 32;
        long bestDen = 1L << 32;
        long bestErr = 1L << 32;

        long b = 1;
        while (b <= n) {
            long a = Math.max(x * b / y - 10, 0L);
            long j = 0;
            while (j < 20) {
                long num = a + j;
                long err = Math.abs(x * b - num * y);
                if (bestErr * b > err * bestDen) {
                    bestErr = err;
                    bestNum = num;
                    bestDen = b;
                } else if (bestErr * b == err * bestDen) {
                    if (bestDen > b || (bestDen == b && bestNum > num)) {
                        bestErr = err;
                        bestNum = num;
                        bestDen = b;
                    }
                }
                ++j;
            }
            ++b;
        }

        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
    }
}
